alterations.name: 绢云母化
alterations.description: 热液作用使长石等矿物转变为绢云母的蚀变过程。常与黄铁矿化、黄铜矿化伴生，是寻找含金石英脉的重要标志。
alterations.description_en: Hydrothermal alteration where feldspar is converted to sericite. Often associated with pyrite and chalcopyrite mineralization. Important indicator for gold-bearing quartz veins.

alterations.name: 绿泥石化
alterations.description: 铁镁质矿物被绿泥石替代的蚀变作用。常见于基性火山岩和侵入岩中，是寻找铜矿床的重要标志。
alterations.description_en: Replacement of ferromagnesian minerals by chlorite. Common in basic volcanic rocks and intrusives. Important indicator for copper deposits.

alterations.name: 硅化
alterations.description: 热液携带的二氧化硅沉淀交代岩石的蚀变作用。可形成硅化带或石英脉，是金矿等热液矿床的重要找矿标志。
alterations.description_en: Silica precipitation and replacement by hydrothermal fluids. Forms silicified zones or quartz veins. Important indicator for hydrothermal gold deposits.

alterations.name: 黄铁矿化
alterations.description: 热液作用使硫化物沉淀的蚀变现象。常与金矿、铜矿伴生，是寻找多金属矿床的重要标志。
alterations.description_en: Sulfide precipitation by hydrothermal fluids. Often associated with gold and copper deposits. Important indicator for polymetallic deposits.

alterations.name: 碳酸盐化
alterations.description: 热液作用使岩石发生碳酸盐化的蚀变过程。常与铅锌矿、金矿伴生，是重要的找矿标志。
alterations.description_en: Hydrothermal alteration resulting in carbonate minerals. Often associated with lead-zinc and gold deposits. Important exploration indicator.

alterations.name: 萤石化
alterations.description: 热液作用使萤石沉淀的蚀变现象。常与铅锌矿、稀土矿伴生，是重要的找矿标志。
alterations.description_en: Fluorite precipitation by hydrothermal fluids. Often associated with lead-zinc and rare earth deposits. Important exploration indicator.

alterations.name: 钠长石化
alterations.description: 热液带入钠使斜长石转变为钠长石的过程。常见于碱性花岗岩和某些铜矿床中。
alterations.description_en: Conversion of plagioclase to albite by sodium-rich hydrothermal fluids. Common in alkaline granites and some copper deposits.

alterations.name: 钾长石化
alterations.description: 热液带入钾使岩石发生钾长石化。常与斑岩铜矿、金矿伴生，是重要的找矿标志。
alterations.description_en: Introduction of potassium by hydrothermal fluids causing K-feldspar formation. Often associated with porphyry copper and gold deposits.

alterations.name: 黑云母化
alterations.description: 热液作用使岩石产生黑云母的蚀变过程。
alterations.description_en: Hydrothermal alteration producing biotite minerals in host rocks.

alterations.name: 角闪石化
alterations.description: 热液作用使岩石产生角闪石的蚀变过程。
alterations.description_en: Formation of hornblende through hydrothermal alteration.

alterations.name: 绿帘石化
alterations.description: 热液作用使岩石发生绿帘石化。常见于基性火山岩的蚀变带中。
alterations.description_en: Hydrothermal alteration producing epidote minerals. Common in altered basic volcanic rocks.

alterations.name: 电气石化
alterations.description: 热液作用使岩石产生电气石的蚀变过程。常与锡矿、黑钨矿伴生。
alterations.description_en: Formation of tourmaline through hydrothermal fluids. Often associated with tin and wolframite deposits.

alterations.name: 白云母化
alterations.description: 热液作用使岩石产生白云母的蚀变过程。
alterations.description_en: Hydrothermal alteration producing muscovite in host rocks.

alterations.name: 石榴石化
alterations.description: 矽卡岩中常见的蚀变矿物组合。石榴石的出现指示接触交代变质作用，是寻找铁矿、铜矿的重要标志。
alterations.description_en: Common alteration mineral in skarn. Garnet presence indicates contact metasomatism. Important indicator for iron and copper deposits.

alterations.name: 透辉石化
alterations.description: 矽卡岩中常见的单斜辉石蚀变矿物。常与铁矿、铜矿伴生。
alterations.description_en: Common monoclonic pyroxene in skarn. Often associated with iron and copper deposits.

alterations.name: 透闪石化
alterations.description: 接触变质带常见的角闪石族矿物。常与大理岩、矽卡岩伴生。
alterations.description_en: Common amphibole in contact metamorphic zones. Often associated with marble and skarn.

alterations.name: 符山石化
alterations.description: 矽卡岩中常见的蚀变矿物，指示高温接触变质作用。
alterations.description_en: Common skarn mineral indicating high-temperature contact metamorphism.

alterations.name: 蛇纹石化
alterations.description: 超基性岩的水化蚀变作用，使橄榄石转变为蛇纹石。常与石棉、滑石伴生，可作为找矿线索。
alterations.description_en: Hydration alteration of ultramafic rocks, converting olivine to serpentine. Often associated with asbestos and talc deposits.

alterations.name: 滑石化
alterations.description: 超基性岩经蚀变形成滑石的矿物组合。常与蛇纹石、石棉伴生。
alterations.description_en: Alteration of ultramafic rocks forming talc. Often associated with serpentine and asbestos.

alterations.name: 伊利石化
alterations.description: 粘土矿物蚀变类型，常由长石蚀变形成。指示中等温度热液作用。
alterations.description_en: Clay mineral alteration type, commonly from feldspar alteration. Indicates moderate temperature hydrothermal activity.

alterations.name: 高岭石化
alterations.description: 酸性热液使长石蚀变成高岭石的粘土化过程。常与金矿、钨矿伴生。
alterations.description_en: Acid hydrothermal alteration converting feldspar to kaolin clay. Often associated with gold and tungsten deposits.

alterations.name: 蒙脱石化
alterations.description: 火山凝灰岩等岩石的粘土化蚀变，形成蒙脱石。
alterations.description_en: Clay alteration of volcanic tuff forming montmorillonite.

alterations.name: 叶蜡石化
alterations.description: 高级粘土矿物蚀变，形成叶蜡石。指示高温热液作用，常与金矿伴生。
alterations.description_en: Advanced clay mineral alteration forming pyrophyllite. Indicates high-temperature hydrothermal activity, often associated with gold.

alterations.name: 明矾石化
alterations.description: 酸性热液形成的硫酸盐矿物蚀变。
alterations.description_en: Sulfate mineral alteration formed by acidic hydrothermal fluids.

alterations.name: 重晶石化
alterations.description: 热液作用使重晶石沉淀的蚀变现象。常与铅锌矿伴生。
alterations.description_en: Barium sulfate precipitation by hydrothermal fluids. Often associated with lead-zinc deposits.

alterations.name: 硬石膏化
alterations.description: 热液作用形成硬石膏的蚀变过程。
alterations.description_en: Formation of anhydrite through hydrothermal alteration.

alterations.name: 磁铁矿化
alterations.description: 热液作用使铁元素形成磁铁矿的蚀变。常与铁矿、斑岩铜矿伴生。
alterations.description_en: Formation of magnetite by iron precipitation from hydrothermal fluids. Often associated with iron and porphyry copper deposits.

alterations.name: 赤铁矿化
alterations.description: 氧化条件下形成的铁氧化物蚀变。
alterations.description_en: Iron oxide alteration formed under oxidation conditions.

alterations.name: 钛铁矿化
alterations.description: 热液作用形成钛铁矿的蚀变过程。
alterations.description_en: Formation of ilmenite through hydrothermal alteration.

alterations.name: 闪锌矿化
alterations.description: 热液作用使锌硫化物沉淀的蚀变现象。是最重要的铅锌矿找矿标志之一。
alterations.description_en: Zinc sulfide precipitation by hydrothermal fluids. One of the most important lead-zinc exploration indicators.

alterations.name: 方铅矿化
alterations.description: 热液作用使铅硫化物沉淀的蚀变现象。常与闪锌矿伴生，形成铅锌矿床。
alterations.description_en: Lead sulfide precipitation by hydrothermal fluids. Often associated with sphalerite forming lead-zinc deposits.

alterations.name: 黄铜矿化
alterations.description: 热液作用使铜硫化物沉淀的蚀变现象。斑岩铜矿的重要找矿标志。
alterations.description_en: Copper sulfide precipitation by hydrothermal fluids. Important indicator for porphyry copper deposits.

alterations.name: 辉钼矿化
alterations.description: 热液作用使钼硫化物沉淀的蚀变现象。常与斑岩铜矿伴生。
alterations.description_en: Molybdenum sulfide precipitation by hydrothermal fluids. Often associated with porphyry copper deposits.

alterations.name: 辉锑矿化
alterations.description: 热液作用使锑硫化物沉淀的蚀变现象。锑矿床的重要找矿标志。
alterations.description_en: Antimony sulfide precipitation by hydrothermal fluids. Important indicator for antimony deposits.

alterations.name: 毒砂化
alterations.description: 热液作用形成的含砧矿物。常与金矿、钨矿伴生，是重要的找矿标志。
alterations.description_en: Arsenic-bearing mineral formed by hydrothermal fluids. Often associated with gold and tungsten deposits.

alterations.name: 雌黄化
alterations.description: 低温热液形成的砷硫化物矿物。
alterations.description_en: Arsenic sulfide mineral formed by low-temperature hydrothermal fluids.

alterations.name: 雄黄化
alterations.description: 低温热液形成的砷硫化物矿物，常与雌黄伴生。
alterations.description_en: Arsenic sulfide mineral formed by low-temperature hydrothermal fluids, often associated with realgar.

alterations.name: 辰砂化
alterations.description: 低温热液形成的汞硫化物矿物。是最重要的汞矿找矿标志。
alterations.description_en: Mercury sulfide formed by low-temperature hydrothermal fluids. Most important indicator for mercury deposits.

alterations.name: 辉银矿化
alterations.description: 热液作用形成的银硫化物矿物。常与方铅矿、闪锌矿伴生。
alterations.description_en: Silver sulfide formed by hydrothermal fluids. Often associated with galena and sphalerite.

alterations.name: 次生石英岩化
alterations.description: 强烈硅化作用形成的次生石英岩。是金矿、钨矿的重要找矿标志。
alterations.description_en: Intense silicification forming secondary quartzite. Important indicator for gold and tungsten deposits.

alterations.name: 蛋白石化
alterations.description: 低温热液形成的非晶质二氧化硅矿物。
alterations.description_en: Amorphous silica mineral formed by low-temperature hydrothermal fluids.

alterations.name: 玉髓化
alterations.description: 低温热液形成的隐晶质二氧化硅矿物。
alterations.description_en: Cryptocrystalline silica formed by low-temperature hydrothermal fluids.

alterations.name: 褪色作用
alterations.description: 热液使岩石褪色，主要是铁镁质矿物被移除的蚀变过程。
alterations.description_en: Removal of iron and magnesium minerals causing rock discoloration.

alterations.name: 赤铁矿化(蚀变)
alterations.description: 岩石中铁元素氧化形成的赤铁矿化。
alterations.description_en: Iron oxidation forming hematite in host rocks.

metadata.source: USGS, Geology Science, 中国地质调查局
